blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI applied to Retail & Consumer Banking. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Retail banks fight on experience and cost per account: onboarding friction, service resolution and cross-sell precision decide share of wallet. The machinery underneath — decisioning, document intelligence, contact platforms — is where Dataq Software engineers advantage.

items: IVR and chatbots deflect volume but not intent; repeat contact and CSAT decay while cost per contact climbs. Agents inherit escalations without context.
Account opening abandons at KYC and document stages; manual checks take days while fintechs approve in minutes. Drop-off concentrates exactly where policy risk is highest.

blocks.x: The pattern composes LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations, Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmapping, Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Systems from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Account opening and KYC, Payment disputes and exceptions, Contact-center resolution) on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — KYC/AML directives among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Align AI to P&L lines and risk mandates — a sequenced portfolio, not a pile of pilots.
One governed platform, many GenAI products: retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services.
Own your models: tune, distill and operate LLMs with measurable quality, controlled cost and enforceable policy.
Grounded assistant across app/voice resolving top intents with citations (cost per contact down 30%+)

blocks.caption: Regimes shaping this capability
rows: customer due diligence with periodic refresh duties
strong customer authentication with friction trade-offs
ICT risk, incident reporting, resilience testing and third-party oversight obligations with supervisory scrutiny

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Banking & Financial Services level this capability reads as: relationship teams query the research corpus in policy-bounded language with compliance-approved phrasing (research turnaround from days to minutes). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
